name: Angel Blade
source:
In the near future, the earth is covered in a chemical smog and Dark Mother, evil villainess, leads a secret organization devoted to world domination. But there is a masked heroine named Angel Blade, a beautiful woman who fights the evil of Dark Mother.

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2601]ANN[/url]]
translation:
近未来，地球被化学烟雾笼罩，邪恶女首领“黑暗母亲”率领一个致力于征服世界的秘密组织。
而一位名为“天使之刃”的蒙面女英雄，正以美丽的身姿同黑暗母亲的邪恶势力战斗。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2601]ANN[/url]]
